messages:
mira: quickstart CI started failing after the sdk update. embeddings call returns 401 but hitting the REST endpoint with curl works. repo: github.com/redwood/sample-apps/llm-quickstart

dennis: can you paste the failing stack?

mira: `Error: 401 Unauthorized - missing Authorization header` (node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/fetch.js:67)

olivia: hmm. the sample app uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and constructs `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`. did sdk change the header behavior?

dennis: yes — sdk v0.12.x will emit `X-Redwood-Key` for `apiKey` to support legacy on-prem proxies. that was intended to be opt-in for private installs but looks like it made its way into hosted calls.

mira: that matches: curl uses Bearer so it succeeds, sdk sets X-Redwood-Key so gateway rejects. also noticed tests set `timeout_ms` in calls; REST expects `timeout_seconds` and the gateway treats the value as seconds -> mismatch.

olivia: two parity problems then: auth header name and timeout units. additionally, i observed sdk retry logic ignoring `Retry-After` header on 429s which produces hammering behavior on backend during flakey infra.

dennis: plan: 1) quickfix for CI — switch the test harness to call hosted REST directly with `Authorization: Bearer ${REDWOOD_API_KEY}`. 2) sdk patch: in hosted mode always send `Authorization: Bearer ...` when token present; accept both `timeout_ms` and `timeout_seconds` in client surface and normalize to ms; make retryer respect `Retry-After` for 429/503.

mira: can you also add a short e2e that runs the quickstart against sandbox to catch this in CI?

dennis: yep. i'll open PRs for a 0.12.4 patch today and add an integration test. will include changelog note and migration snippet recommending `REDWOOD_TOKEN` env var.

dx-bot: created issue #4892: "SDK parity: hosted header + timeout unit mismatch + retry-after handling" assigned to @dennis

olivia: thx — i pushed a temporary [quickfix] to CI to unblock tests. once sdk patch lands we'll revert. :white_check_mark:
